question: Do eight frozen restricted-SVD rank-one factors differ in causal effect between Huginn calls 1–8 and 9–16 after matched intervention magnitude?
headline: Three small read-control-adjusted timing differences; nominated strong temporal roles are not supported
assessment: partial_signal: three of eight R-only interactions reject zero after Holm, but none of four early-/late-only nominations meets the pre-registered active harm criterion. W causal confirmation was not authorized or run.

decision_rule.registered_primary: For each of eight factors, paired factor-minus-mean-four-R-controls correct-digit log probability shift in late calls 9–16 minus early calls 1–8; program-clustered sign-flip p and Holm correction across eight.
decision_rule.matching: Four fixed R matrices per factor; independently verified p10,p50,p90 relative errors <=15%, p95 <=25% in each window. Check applied original-hook BF16 quantiles before confirmation.
decision_rule.temporal_nomination: For four early_only/late_only hypotheses, active harmful effect <−0.05 nats with 95% interval excluding zero, plus inactive-window unadjusted 90% equivalence interval inside ±0.05 nats. Large_effect and near_null nominations have separate labels; do not apply this criterion to them.
decision_rule.inference: 3000 program-clustered bootstrap draws retaining all three seeds and 9999 clustered sign flips; Holm over eight R interactions only. Equivalence intervals are not familywise adjusted.

methods.instrument: Original-weight BF16 hook subtracts frozen rank-one factor or the same four selection-frozen read-rotation matrices in calls 1–8 or 9–16; same full-deck batches, padding, source order, noise seeds; zero-edit identity and known-edit checks passed.
methods.control_family: R read_rotation only; W write_rotation causal comparison not executed.

results.R_control_gate: 8/8 factors, 4/4 controls each, both windows; applied BF16 64/64 factor-control-window matches
results.previous_failure: Old retrospective archive had 81/144 controls and only 10/36 full cases; 11/36 old pools lacked four matching candidates (post-hoc). Original W prospective STOP was a float32/float64 equality-check error, preserved. Corrected numerical check changed 1e-8 to 1e-6, not the 15/25% registered matching threshold. Both W and R control gates subsequently passed, but the researcher approved only R causal confirmation.

limitations: The factors came from a restricted top-64 SVD surrogate, not a full VPD fit, so their nominated roles do not establish an expert factorization.

The R matching rule covers the immediate clean answer-position norm distribution, not every token or downstream edited-state norm. Four R directions are correlated candidates, not independent trials; inference clusters programs rather than claiming generality over control draws.

Half the sealed deck qualified by all-three-seed clean correctness; conclusions are conditional on these 240 programs. The inactive-window 90% equivalence intervals are per nomination and not familywise adjusted. W matched but has no causal outcome.

Second main-text display: early and late control-adjusted effects for all eight factors, clarifying role labels and the 0.05-nat harmful criterion.
R 8/8 independent matching control; intact old W STOP and repair; harmed/helped/reversal examples from saved R item records; no W causal figures.
